Aggregate a refactored fabric to the distribution network (aggregate phase)

Source: R/aggregate_fabric.R
aggregate_fabric.Rd

Consumes stage-1 artifacts; produces the aggregated network + divides

  • remapped POIs in a single out_vpu{id}.gpkg. No raster access.

Usage

aggregate_fabric(
  vpuid,
  fabric_dir,
  out_dir,
  min_fragment_m = 5,
  threshold_m2 = 1000,
  gap_fill_area = 0,
  overlap_rule = "max-area",
  snap_interval = 1e-08,
  min_length_km = 0.25,
  min_area_sqkm = 3,
  ideal_size_sqkm = 10,
  max_area_sqkm = 15,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

vpuid

VPU identifier.

fabric_dir

Path to the vpu working directory holding the refactored fabric.

out_dir

Parent output directory; vpu_{vpuid}/ is created.

min_fragment_m

Sub-threshold flowpath collapse length (m), Step 3c.

threshold_m2

fill_small_holes area threshold on divides (m^2).

gap_fill_area

Gap-fill area for hfutils::clean_gpkg_layer.

overlap_rule

Divide overlap resolution rule.

snap_interval

mapshaper snap interval (degrees); collapses degenerate edges.

min_length_km

Aggregate-to-distribution flowpath length threshold (km).

min_area_sqkm

Aggregate-to-distribution divide area threshold (km^2). The minimum a unit must reach, applied ahead of max_area_sqkm.

ideal_size_sqkm

Divide area the collapse aims a merged unit at (km^2).

max_area_sqkm

Divide area a merged unit is not carried past (km^2), except where no receiver has room for a unit below min_area_sqkm.

verbose

Propagated to internal helpers.

Value

Invisibly, a list with files, timings.

Details

Reads stage-1 outputs from disk, splits the rec_div layer into landscape vs network on read, and exposes the stage's tunable thresholds as documented arguments.

Writes to {out_dir}/vpu_{vpuid}/work/:

  • out_vpu{id}.gpkg: layers: flowpaths (aggregated), divides, network (the aspatial topology table), pois, small_segments, and optional landscape_divides

  • timings.json

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
aggregate_fabric(vpuid      = "01",
                 fabric_dir = "out/vpu_01",
                 out_dir    = "out",
                 min_area_sqkm = 5)
} # }
